tables.name: vercel_events
tables.comment: Vercel Drain logs, HTTP requests, Web Analytics pageviews/events, Speed Insights vitals, and application events

columns.name: service
columns.comment: Vercel project name, project ID, or service identifier

columns.name: event_type
columns.comment: vercel.request, vercel.log, vercel.pageview, vercel.custom_event, or vercel.web_vital

columns.name: outcome
columns.comment: Execution or HTTP outcome (ok, client_error, error)

columns.name: path
columns.comment: Request URL pathname without query parameters

columns.name: request_id
columns.comment: Vercel request ID (x-vercel-id) or drain record ID

columns.name: message
columns.comment: Human-readable request summary, runtime log line, custom event name, or Web Vital summary

columns.name: attributes
columns.comment: Structured Vercel deployment, edge cache, geography, attribution, trace, or Web Vital metadata

views.name: v_vercel_requests
views.comment: Flattened Vercel HTTP request, edge cache, function execution, and trace metrics
views.statement:
FROM scopedb.guide_vercel.vercel_events
WHERE event_type = 'vercel.request'
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    outcome,
    level,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    request_id,
    message,
    attributes['run_id']::string AS run_id,
    attributes['project_id']::string AS project_id,
    attributes['deployment_id']::string AS deployment_id,
    attributes['environment']::string AS environment,
    attributes['branch']::string AS branch,
    attributes['source']::string AS source,
    attributes['route']::string AS route,
    attributes['entrypoint']::string AS entrypoint,
    attributes['region']::string AS region,
    attributes['execution_region']::string AS execution_region,
    attributes['vercel_cache']::string AS vercel_cache,
    attributes['duration_ms']::float AS duration_ms,
    attributes['trace_id']::string AS trace_id,
    attributes['span_id']::string AS span_id,
    attributes['user_agent']::string AS user_agent,
    attributes['referer_host']::string AS referer_host,
    attributes['referer_path']::string AS referer_path,
    attributes['query'] AS query,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_source']::string, attributes['query']['utm_source'][0]::string) AS utm_source,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_medium']::string, attributes['query']['utm_medium'][0]::string) AS utm_medium,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_campaign']::string, attributes['query']['utm_campaign'][0]::string) AS utm_campaign,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_term']::string, attributes['query']['utm_term'][0]::string) AS utm_term,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_content']::string, attributes['query']['utm_content'][0]::string) AS utm_content,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['ref']::string, attributes['query']['ref'][0]::string) AS ref

views.name: v_vercel_pageviews
views.comment: Client-reported Web Analytics pageviews (vercel.pageview) and successful HTTP GET document requests (vercel.request); filter by event_type to avoid double-counting when both Drains are enabled
views.statement:
FROM scopedb.guide_vercel.vercel_events
WHERE event_type = 'vercel.pageview' OR (event_type = 'vercel.request' AND method = 'GET' AND status = 200)
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    event_type,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    attributes['run_id']::string AS run_id,
    attributes['environment']::string AS environment,
    attributes['route']::string AS route,
    attributes['country']::string AS country,
    attributes['region']::string AS region,
    attributes['city']::string AS city,
    attributes['device_type']::string AS device_type,
    attributes['os_name']::string AS os_name,
    attributes['client_name']::string AS client_name,
    if(
        attributes['referer_host']::string = host
            OR attributes['referer_host']::string = concat('www.', host)
            OR concat('www.', attributes['referer_host']::string) = host,
        NULL,
        attributes['referer_host']::string
    ) AS referer_host,
    if(
        attributes['referer_host']::string = host
            OR attributes['referer_host']::string = concat('www.', host)
            OR concat('www.', attributes['referer_host']::string) = host,
        NULL,
        attributes['referer_path']::string
    ) AS referer_path,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_source']::string, attributes['query']['utm_source'][0]::string) AS utm_source,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_medium']::string, attributes['query']['utm_medium'][0]::string) AS utm_medium,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_campaign']::string, attributes['query']['utm_campaign'][0]::string) AS utm_campaign,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_term']::string, attributes['query']['utm_term'][0]::string) AS utm_term,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['utm_content']::string, attributes['query']['utm_content'][0]::string) AS utm_content,
    if(attributes['query'] IS NULL, attributes['ref']::string, attributes['query']['ref'][0]::string) AS ref,
    attributes['query'] AS query,
    attributes['user_agent']::string AS user_agent
WHERE path IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/api/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/_next/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/_vercel/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/_app/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/.')
  AND NOT ends_with(path, '/__data.json')
  AND NOT regexp_like(path, regex => '(?i)[.](md|txt|xml|ico|svg|png|jpg|jpeg|webp|gif|css|js|map|json|woff2?)$')
  AND (user_agent IS NULL OR NOT regexp_like(user_agent, regex => '(?i)(bot|crawler|spider|slurp|facebookexternalhit|feedbin|pingwatch|uptime|statuscake|cortex-xpanse|paloaltonetworks|censys|shodan|zgrab|curl|wget|python|go-http-client|axios|node-fetch|undici|okhttp|headless|Claude-User|ChatGPT-User|Perplexity-User|Anthropic|cohere-ai|Cursor|Codex)'))

views.name: v_vercel_errors
views.comment: Vercel 5xx HTTP responses, runtime error logs, and failed outcomes
views.statement:
FROM scopedb.guide_vercel.vercel_events
WHERE level = 'error' OR outcome = 'error' OR (status IS NOT NULL AND status >= 500)
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    event_type,
    outcome,
    level,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    request_id,
    message,
    attributes['run_id']::string AS run_id,
    attributes['deployment_id']::string AS deployment_id,
    attributes['environment']::string AS environment,
    attributes['source']::string AS source,
    attributes['trace_id']::string AS trace_id,
    attributes['span_id']::string AS span_id,
    attributes

views.name: v_vercel_ai_bots
views.comment: AI user-agent requests and Markdown/llms.txt content access, with separate identity and content signals
views.statement:
FROM scopedb.guide_vercel.vercel_events
WHERE event_type = 'vercel.request'
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    outcome,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    request_id,
    attributes['run_id']::string AS run_id,
    attributes['environment']::string AS environment,
    attributes['region']::string AS region,
    attributes['vercel_cache']::string AS vercel_cache,
    attributes['user_agent']::string AS user_agent,
    attributes['referer_host']::string AS referer_host
SELECT *,
    if(regexp_like(user_agent, regex => '(?i)(ClaudeBot|Claude-Web|Claude-User|Anthropic|GPTBot|ChatGPT-User|OAI-SearchBot|Codex|Cursor|PerplexityBot|Perplexity-User|CCBot|Google-Extended|Applebot-Extended|Bytespider|Amazonbot|cohere-ai|YouBot)'), true, false) AS is_ai_user_agent,
    if(path = '/llms.txt' OR ends_with(path, '.md'), true, false) AS is_markdown_request
WHERE is_ai_user_agent OR is_markdown_request
